no_face_cycle._doc: period 1 = EVERY hero is no-face. Was 3 (the composition tell gaze rotation cannot reach). This is the safety default until Kevin picks a posture; restoring 3 is a one-token edit, but do not restore it merely because the bank has faces in it again.
